caseNameFull: Jeffries v. Duffy, Warden Taylor v. Squier, Warden Fleenor v. Hunter, Warden Poleski v. Ohio and Pentz v. Steele, Warden

opinions.text: The motions for leave to file petitions for writs of habeas corpus in these eases are severally denied. Petitioners pro se. Solicitor General Perlman for respondent in No. 158, Misc.
